full_prompt_en: A wide cinematic action image shows a dark car moving across a shadowed road before an enormous wall of orange fire. The low car occupies the lower left and center of the frame, seen from the side at a slight angle. Its roof, windshield, hood, and rear body are readable mainly as dark blue-black shapes against the blaze. A faint reflection skims the upper edges, while the windows remain nearly opaque. The ground runs as a narrow dim band along the bottom, stained with purple-blue shadow and warm spill from the flames. Behind the vehicle, the explosion extends almost the full width and height of the frame. Its brightest white-yellow pockets gather near the center and upper right, surrounded by turbulent orange, red, and smoke-darkened folds. At the left edge, smaller tongues of flame lean toward the car; on the right, the fire grows into a broad billowing mass. Fine glowing flecks and rough smoke texture give the background a restless surface. No people, buildings, or readable text appear in this selected image. The image uses a strong warm-cool separation: incandescent fire forms a luminous backdrop, while the car and road remain dark and comparatively still. The lighting comes overwhelmingly from behind the vehicle, outlining its roof and hood but leaving the near side in deep shade. The frame is low and horizontal, intensifying the sense of forward motion without showing a long stretch of road. The central car silhouette interrupts the otherwise continuous field of flame. The overall composition is stark and explosive, built from one dark moving shape against a vast, high-energy orange glow.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅宽银幕感的动作画面：一辆深色汽车驶过阴暗道路，身后是巨大的橙色火墙。低矮汽车占据下方左侧和中央，以略带角度的侧面呈现。车顶、挡风玻璃、引擎盖和车尾主要靠深蓝黑形状在火光前辨认。淡淡反光掠过上方边缘，车窗仍近乎不透明。地面沿底边形成一条窄而暗的带状区域，混有紫蓝阴影与火焰洒下的暖光。汽车后面，爆炸几乎延伸到画框全部宽度和高度。最亮的白黄色火团聚在中央与右上，外面包着翻涌的橙、红与烟熏暗褶。左边缘较小火舌向汽车倾斜；右侧火焰则长成宽阔的翻卷团块。细小发光颗粒和粗粝烟雾肌理让背景表面躁动。所选画面没有人物、建筑或可读文字。画面采用强烈冷暖分离：白炽火焰成为发亮背景，汽车和道路则维持深暗、相对稳定。光主要从车后进入，勾出车顶与引擎盖，却让近侧陷入深影。画框低矮而横向，虽未展示长路段，仍强化了前进动势。中央汽车剪影截断原本连续的火焰色场。整体构图严峻而爆裂，由一个深色移动形状对抗巨大的高能橙色辉光。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic image-making uses wide, low framing and extreme warm-cool separation to build immediate impact. A dark, compact silhouette sits against a much larger field of turbulent orange-red light, so backlighting rather than surface detail defines its form. White-yellow hot spots break through smoky crimson folds, with fine sparks and rough atmospheric texture animating the brightest mass. Cooler blue-purple shadows keep the lower and nearer planes distinct from the incandescent background. Edges flare where light wraps around them, while near-facing surfaces remain almost black. The overall effect is forceful and kinetic, concentrating visual energy in the collision between one readable dark mass and a vast luminous field.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感图像采用宽而低的画框和极端冷暖分离制造直接冲击。紧凑深色剪影位于更巨大的翻腾橙红光场前，因此逆光而非表面细节界定其形态。白黄色热亮点冲破烟熏深红褶层，细火星和粗糙大气肌理激活最亮的大块。较冷的蓝紫阴影把下方和近处平面与白炽背景区分开。光线绕过边缘之处出现亮边，面向观众的表面则几乎保持黑色。整体效果强劲、充满动势，把视觉能量集中在一个可辨的深色大块与广阔发光色场的碰撞中。
theme_en: A dark car racing before a vast wall of fire
theme_zh: 深色汽车从巨大的火墙前疾驰而过
name: Michael Bay
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
